notes.title: Mini Content Update 1.0.4 is now Live!
notes.notes:
Thank you for sharing your thoughts on Steam forums and reviews - your vigilance and feedback makes a huge impact to the game's continued development!
[h3][b]New Features:[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Twelve new 'Loss' CGs, to unlock them you just have to lose a game and get a 'Game Over' against any Boss
[*] Three game mode options to choose from! Classic, Gauntlet and Ascension! Classic is avaliable for now, with Gauntlet hopefully arriving by the end of this month.
[/list][h3][b]Info:[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Classic game mode: Use prebuilt decks to dominate other sorceresses and become Edge Lord in a short campaign
[*] Gauntlet Mod: Gain cards from bosses and event encounters to upgrade your deck in a medium-length campaign
[*] Ascension Mode: Create and customise your own deck as you explore the Edge in an epic extended-length campaign
[/list][h3][b]Fixed Bugs[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] When you go to select a character, the default outfit may not represent your selection
[*] Cards that only do minion damage not say they do
[*] Various typos and grammar corrections
[/list][h3][b]Stuff we're working on right now[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Adding 30 events to Gauntlet mode
[*] Adding 150 cards to Gauntlet mode
[*] Writing 72 unique interactions for the girls
[*] Interactive tutorial

[/list]Here's a sneak peak at the new event system for the Gauntlet game mode:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42164866/1783c2d4085148750d51beb0c03b180fc237b365.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Content Update 1.1.0 Coming Soon!
notes.notes:
Thank you for your vigilance and feedback that you shared on the Steam forums and helped us create a fun, balanced and stable build.

Since we last spoke we have been diligently working on Version 1.1 which we plan on releasing July 26th and will upgrade the EdgeLords experience with new features that you have requested.
[h3][b]New Features for Version 1.1:[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] New 'Loss' CGs (x12)
[*] New Gauntlet Game Mode: Gain cards between battles!
[*] New Event System: 30,000 words of professionally-written erotic fiction
[*] Official support for Spanish Languages (Latin and Spain)
[*] Steam Trading Cards, Backgrounds, Avatars, Emoticons and Badges!
[*] Improved Anal Gapes
[/list][h3][b]Be Advised:[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] All content updates are free! We never sell DLC or microtransactions
[*] Content update release dates may be subject to change
[*] From 1.1, the current game mode will be called 'Classic Mode'
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42164866/92b88b5984428102175ace9ab6d05eb8ef3f5d29.png[/img]
[i]The CGs and events for Version 1.1 are all illustrated and written, we are just in the process of adding them to the game.[/i]

[h3][b]Future Plans:[/b][/h3]
We are currently working on getting our grand plan complete: v1.2 - Ascension Game Mode.
Ascension mode will offer everything Gauntlet mode provides [i]plus [/i]the following:
[list]
[*] 4 New Miniboss girls
[*] Twice as many battles per campaign
[*] New Outfit - Edge Lord
[*] 12 New Animated CGs
[*] New Zone - Throne Room
[*] 6 New Music Tracks
[*] 400 New Lines of Voice Acting
[*] More official language support
[*] +many more Quality of Life features
[/list]
Because this will take a while to complete Ascension mode (ETA December 2023, but may take much, much longer) we are releasing Gauntlet mode to whet your appetite.

Thanks for the wonderful fanart! If you have made any or see any in the wild, we'd love to showcase it! Please feel free to let us know!

notes.title: Hotfix Patch 1.0.3 is now Live!
notes.notes:
Thank you for your vigilance and feedback that you shared on the Steam forums, you have helped identify dozens of small bugs that we have been able to rectify. 
[h3][b]New Features:[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] The way outfits unlock has changed, now to unlock an outfit for a character, you need to win a game in that area with that character.
[*] The logic for earning green completionist skulls has been corrected. However this means that any earned skulls have been reset.
[/list][h3][b]Be Advised:[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] This version (1.0.3) changes game logic, if you attempt to 'continue' a run that started in an older version (such as 1.0.2) it may 'load forever' and you will have to close the EdgeLords application.
[*] This version changes unlock logic, green completionist skulls may have been reset.
[/list][h3][b]Fixed Bugs[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Dark Stallion x Efrit/Afterimage ghost clone bug
[*] Deathgrip's head not granting +3 Timer Counters to Overfiend Ritual/Ragnorak
[*] Motif and green completionist skull logic corrected
[*] Player Lilith Djinn's Wish card 'Sanctity' effect is corrected
[*] Player Lilith Cleric's Enshrine card now exhausts
[*] Attempting to summon more Glyphs than the board can handle no longer softlocks
[*] Player DG's Overfiend is now invincible 
[*] Fixed CGs unlocking too early
[*] Harpy successfully grants +2 Actions on defeat
[*] Overager now grants +2 Climax
[*] Various typos and grammar corrections
[/list][h3][b]Stuff we're working on right now[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Deck edit mode
[*] Unique loss CG for each character
[/list]Here's a sneak peak at the new CGs, which will be ready by mid-June.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42164866/37469aeebb1bf52b74417bc6a8c00aeddf3934cd.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Difficulty Patch 1.0.2b is now Live!
notes.notes:
[b]The user-requested difficulty patch is now live. This reduces the overall difficulty from Hardcore (Hard) to Competetive (Medium).[/b]

We are continuing to fine-tune the difficulty, in the next few weeks we are planning on developing a difficulty setting to toggle from Casual (Easy), Competetive (Medium) and Hardcore (Hard) and linking it to a new 'essence system'.

In the new 'essence system', players earn essence for completing games, the higher the difficulty, the more essence earned. Essence can then be redeemed on Motifs, CGs and Card Art (this will replace the current unlock system) so you can choose exactly what you'd like to unlock at any time.

User-requested improvements we're working on [b]right now[/b]:
[list]
[*] Steam trading cards, badges and backgrounds (May)
[*] Comprehensive how to play guide (May)
[*] 'BAD END' artwork for EVERY player/boss combination (June)
[*] Viewer for contents of deck and discard piles (June)
[*] More hentai to the gallery (July)
[*] Animation test to gallery (July)
[*] Enhanced rimjobs
[/list]

Thanks again for all of your support! We couldn't do it without you!
